_why: Evergreen walks the feed oldest first, which is right for reaching posts
the timeline never saw. After the 2026-10-03 backfill added 28 posts at
once, oldest first means the first three out are the three oldest, and
age is not strength. This list runs before that order: anything named
here goes first, in this order, then the oldest-first walk resumes.
Chosen for what survives being read six months late: a claim that is
still true, a number the voice gate can ground, and no dependence on a
launch date. Version announcements are deliberately absent - 'MoltGuard
v2', 'now listed on Glama', 'plugin v1.0.0' read as recycled PR when
they resurface, and the gates would pass them anyway.

_notes.kernel-level-agent-enforcement.html: Concrete, technical and surprising, with a real artefact behind it. Travels outside our own audience.
_notes.internal-only-paradox.html: Carries 71% - a figure gate 2 (f) can ground - and the argument is the current positioning: every check inside the operator's own estate.
_notes.paris-weather-polymarket-manipulation.ht: Strongest hook of the set. Held back only because it is the narrowest topic of the six.
Number-led and still true, but February framing.
_notes.compliance-is-not-a-model-property.html: Strong line; the grading it reports is a point in time, so it ages faster than the three above.

2026-10-05: moltproof-announcement.html taken out of the list. The page carried a
'Verification status' block in the delivered HTML with two UNVERIFIED
entries, one of them saying the claims had to be verified before the
post was published - and it had been live since 2026-07-09. The page is
cleaned now (moltrust-web 2954160) and the claims are struck, so this is
a decision about the list and not about the page any more.
